title: Mt Antero Bikepacking with Patrick
description: Video of my bikepacking / hiking adventure with patrick. We biked to the base of Mt. Antero,  camped,  hiked to the summit, then biked home

title: Bikepacking on Marshall Pass Road
description: Biked up on a few miles on a Sunday afternoon, set up camp, went for a hike. Then I packed up early, biked down, and made it back home in time to go to work. Short and sweet
